# RJ Love Shah

> RJ Love Shah is an Indian celebrity anchor, event host, entertainer and Chartered Accountant. He has hosted 1,500+ live events over 11+ years – luxury weddings, corporate shows, sports events and large live shows – including the Ambani family's Reliance Navratri. Before hosting full time he spent 8 years in radio at 94.3 MY FM and Fever FM. Tagline: "Be My Guest".

## Key facts
- Roles: celebrity host / anchor, entertainer, voice artist, former radio jockey (RJ), qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)
- Experience: 1,500+ live events, 11+ years on stage, 8 years in radio (94.3 MY FM, Fever FM)
- Headline credit: host of the Reliance Navratri for the Ambani family (Jamnagar)
- Languages he hosts in: Hindi, English and Gujarati, switching between them to suit the crowd
- Travels for events across India and abroad (destination weddings, events in Sri Lanka, NRI weddings)
- Felicitated by WIRC of ICAI as a Chartered Accountant who excels as an artist

## Events he hosts
- Corporate shows: annual days, awards nights, family days, team building, product launches, Diwali parties
- Luxury weddings: sangeet, haldi, carnival, baraat, varmala, reception, destination and NRI weddings
- Sports and live events: Navratri, concerts, sports properties (e.g. Adani PGTI golf event with Kapil Dev), brand launches

## Celebrities he has shared the stage with
Vicky Kaushal, Kriti Sanon, Rashmika Mandanna, Disha Patani, Varun Dhawan, Malaika Arora, Tiger Shroff, Sidharth Malhotra, Mouni Roy, Taapsee Pannu, Neha Kakkar, Karisma Kapoor, Piyush Mishra.

## Brands and clients
Reliance, Jio, Coca-Cola, BMW, Gujarat Titans, Zydus, SBI Life, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Hero, Swati, Adani.
